name: fee unit
note: The value in Australian dollars of Victoria's fee unit for each financial year from 2020-21 to 2026-27, from the Department of Treasury and Finance's page 'Indexation of fees and penalties' (updated 5 May 2026, read 2026-10-30), which lists each year from 1 July 2020, and from each year's notice by the Treasurer under section 6 of the Monetary Units Act 2004 in the Victoria Government Gazette (all seven saved and read 2026-10-30), which fixes the value 'for the financial year commencing 1 July'. So each value is from 1 July of its year and holds to 30 June of the next, as DTF's page says ('1 July 2026 to 30 June 2027'). DTF's page and the notices agree on every value. DTF's page dates the 2025-26 notice 'Special Gazette S245 dated 22 May 2024'; its link is GG2025S245.pdf and the gazette itself is No. S 245 of Thursday 22 May 2025, so the page's '2024' is a slip and the value is the gazette's. DTF's page gives no year before 2020-21, so earlier values are not held. The 2027-28 value is not published on 2026-10-30. The form doesn't hold the penalty unit, which the same notices fix (2026-27: $209.10), nor the Treasurer's approved annual rate for increasing fees (2.75 per cent for 2026-27), nor the rounding each Act or regulation applies to a fee worked from fee units.
